theorems.name: Submission.stationary_constancy_tangentGraph_measure
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (V : Varifold N n U) (M : Set (Euclidean N)), V.Stationary → Chapter02.IsSimonSubmanifold (E := Euclidean n) 2 M → U ∩ V.weight.support ⊆ M → IsPreconnected (M ∩ U) → M.Nonempty → ∃ (c : ℝ≥0∞) (T : Euclidean N → Grassmannian N n), c ≠ ∞ ∧ Measurable T ∧ V.measure = (c • (μHE[n] : Measure (Euclidean N)).restrict (M ∩ U)).map (fun x ↦ (x, T x)) ∧ (c ≠ 0 → ∀ x ∈ M ∩ U, ((T x).plane : Set (Euclidean N)) = classicalTangentSpace M x)
